Sharded non-inclusion vectors generated by aggregator-go (branch `non-inclusion` @ be24edb, bft-core d5316e99cdb3,
bft-go-base 8c62c75b) with `internal/nifixture` (`NewShardedAuthority(2|3)`, the deterministic public-test-key authority of
the corpus) and judged by Go's `noninclusion.Verifier.VerifyFor`, the reference verdict.

- `sharded-vectors.json`: per authority bits (2 = 4 shards, 3 = 8 shards, the latter only for shards 00.. and 101) the
  trust base JSON, and per case a complete wrapper, the queried state id, the UC's shard and the Go verdict under three
  contexts: `own` (the certified shard), `other` (another shard) and `unsharded` (the empty shard).
- Tree shapes per shard: one, two or three leaves of the shard, and a tree of foreign leaves (belonging to the next shard).
- Queries per tree: absent keys of the shard, each leaf key (inclusion), and a key of every other shard.
- `generator_test.go.txt`: the throwaway Go test that dumped it (`DUMP_OUT=file go test ./internal/nifixture -run
  TestDumpSharded`), kept for regeneration; it is not part of the aggregator-go tree.
